_source: Built-in claude.ai Google Calendar connector, observed 2026-10-16 with read-only calls (Seb approved). Field names and structure only; values are type placeholders, no event content.
_notes: list_events / get_event / search_events return Google Calendar API Event resources nearly verbatim (camelCase), plus a top-level `conferenceUrl` convenience field when there is a Meet link.
list_events wraps events in the Events-list envelope (accessRole, defaultReminders, summary, timeZone, updated, nextPageToken). search_events returns only { events } (no envelope observed).
iCalUID is NOT present in the built-in output. We request it from the API for de-duplication and may include it as an extra field.
Our tools add: account, accountEmail (every item) and accounts[], sources[] (de-duplicated events), plus top-level accountErrors[] and nextCursor (replacing nextPageToken).

start.dateTime: RFC3339 with offset (or date for all-day)

end.dateTime: RFC3339 with offset (or date for all-day)
